exposure: 0 ∼ 1 year interval between present and last pregnancy
2 ∼ 3 year interval between present and last pregnancy
artificial abortion within the last pregnancy
Interval between present and last pregnancy (0-1 year, 2-3 years)
cohort: 206 women with CSP and 412 randomly selected controls with early pregnancies
finding: Vaginal bleeding, lower abdominal pain, history of artificial abortion, and short interpregnancy intervals (0-1 year and 2-3 years) were identified as risk factors for CSP.
